title: Paid product catalog
description: What can be bought and which R2 files each purchase unlocks. Prices are owner decisions (company/policies/pricing-rules.md): change them only in a PR labelled approved-by-owner.

id.description: Stable slug. Also the value of the Razorpay Payment Page field "product", if set.

price_inr.description: Whole rupees, inclusive of taxes. Must differ between buyable products: a payment is matched to a product by its amount when no product field is sent.

status.description: draft: test mode only. live: buyable. retired: no new sales; old download links keep working.

key.description: Object key in the R2 bucket

name.description: File name the buyer's browser saves
